name: Jasmine Gilroy
source:
One of Jake's students, Jasmine, is a rebellious woman who wants to make a name for herself in the world. She enjoys flirting with Jake on occasion, but he is waaaay to old for her (he's over 30, practically ancient!)....Though... you never quite know. Maybe she'll be hot for the teacher one day...

[From [url=https://raceoflifegame.com]Official Site[/url]]
